description:
Manage Focus clients with the following actions:

- **archive** (data: client_id*, payload*{project_count*})
- **create** (data: name*, address, contact_email, currency, internal_reference)
- **delete** (data: client_id*)
- **get** (data: client_id*)
- **get-archive-preview** (data: client_id*)
- **list**: Clients group billable work; projects can reference client_id. Filter projects with projects.list --client-id. (data: name, page, per_page)
- **restore** (data: client_id*)
- **unarchive** (data: client_id*)
- **update** (data: client_id*, payload*{name, address, contact_email, currency, internal_reference})

Pass the action-specific fields under `data` (required fields are marked with *).
Mutations require a confirm_token handshake: call without confirm_token first to receive a token, then call again with the token to confirm.
Optional dry_run: true validates input and returns { dry_run, operation, input } without calling the API.

action.description: One of: archive, create, delete, get, get-archive-preview, list, restore, unarchive, update

confirm_token.description: Mutation confirmation token from previous call

data.description: Action-specific payload. See each action's parameters in this tool's description; pass dry_run: true to validate it without calling the API.
